text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x has design style y.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(zaha, x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
DesignStyle(zaha, design) ⊕ DesignStyle(kelly, design) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(kelly, x) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(kelly, x) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x (DesignStyle(max, x) ∧ Timeless(x) → MassProduct(x) ∧ Evocative(x)) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(designByMax) ∧ Dreamy(designByMax) ::: A design by Max is evocative and dreamy.
